# IRevertiblePluginAction

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IRevertiblePluginAction : IPluginAction
```

An action that profiles can undo. Before a profile changes a setting for the first time, AutoSettings calls [`IRevertiblePluginAction.CaptureAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#captureasync) to save the current value; when the profile ends it calls [`IRevertiblePluginAction.RestoreAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#restoreasync) with that value.

Settings are told apart by the fields marked [`FieldAttribute.KeyField`](FieldAttribute.md#keyfield) (for example the drive letter), so two actions with different key values change different settings.

## Methods

### CaptureAsync

```csharp
Task<string?> CaptureAsync(ActionRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Reads the current value of the setting that `request` would change.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `request` | The parameters of the action that is about to run. |
| `cancellationToken` | Cancellation. |

**Returns:** The value as text (any format you like), or `null` when there is nothing to restore.

### RestoreAsync

```csharp
Task RestoreAsync(ActionRequest request, string? snapshot, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Puts the setting back to a value returned by [`IRevertiblePluginAction.CaptureAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#captureasync).

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `request` | The parameters of the action that changed the setting. |
| `snapshot` | The value returned by [`IRevertiblePluginAction.CaptureAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#captureasync). |
| `cancellationToken` | Cancellation. |
